parsed.summary: Three of the four targets formalize the spherical-code hierarchy results. `main_general` is Theorem 1.2: for strictly interlacing (a,b) with 2Γ_r>s, every s-code in ℝ^n eventually has fewer than 2^{Rn} points for each R>Φ_r, and R_sph(s) is at most the closed-constraint infimum. `strict_hierarchy` is Corollary 1.3, and the last target is an eventual numerical kissing-number bound 2^{0.39661n}. The single most important caveat is that `main_binary_theorem` carries the hypothesis `hbase : (1 : ℕ) = 0`, which is false, so that theorem is vacuous and certifies nothing about binary codes.

glossary.plain: R_sph(s) = limsup_n log2 A(n,s) / n, with A(n,s) taken via ℕ∞.toNat
glossary.note: For s<1, A(n,s) is finite, so toNat does not truncate. A(0,s)=0 and logb 0 = 0 there, which is harmless for a limsup. The sequence is bounded, so the real limsup is meaningful.

glossary.plain: A(n,s) = sup of the cardinalities of finite sets of unit vectors with pairwise inner product ≤ s
Γ_r(a,b) = Σ_ℓ R_ℓ · sqrt(a_ℓ(1+a_ℓ))/(1+2a_ℓ), with R_ℓ the Lagrange weights in the coordinate x=u(1+u)
glossary.note: The full definition is not in the excerpt. Denominators are nonzero under interlacing because u(1+u) is injective on u≥0.

glossary.plain: Φ_r = Σ_ℓ H(a_ℓ) − Σ_m H(b_m), where H(u)=(1+u)log2(1+u) − u log2 u
κ_r(s) = inf Φ_r over interlacing tuples with 2Γ_r>s
glossary.note: At s=0 the paper sets κ_r(0)=0, while Lean uses the infimum, which is plausibly also 0.

glossary.plain: inf over t∈[0,s] of κ(t) + ½ log2((1−t)/(1−s))
inf of H(a)−H(b) over 0<b<a with s<2Γ(a,b)

lean_claims.plain: Assuming 1=0 in ℕ (false), for 0<δ<1/2: R_bin(δ) ≤ combined variational rate < MRRW rate. Vacuous.

For 0<s<1, any r, interlacing a,b with s<2Γ_r(a,b), and R>Φ_r(a,b): for all large n, every s-spherical code in ℝ^n has fewer than 2^{Rn} points. Also R_sph(s) ≤ inf of Φ_r over interlacing tuples with s ≤ 2Γ_r.
For 0<s<1 and all r: κ_{r+1}(s)<κ_r(s) and κ̄_{r+1}(s)<κ̄_r(s), where κ̄ denotes the localized version. Also R_sph ≤ inf_r κ̄_r < κ̄_1 < κ̄_row < κ̄_0 = classical localized rate.
For all sufficiently large n, the kissing number in ℝ^n is ≤ 2^{0.39661 n}.

paper_claims.plain: For interlacing a,b with 2Γ_r>s: A(n,s) ≤ 2^{(Φ_r+o(1))n}; hence R_sph(s) ≤ inf over r,a,b with 2Γ_r ≥ s of Φ_r.
κ_{r+1}<κ_r and κ̄_{r+1}<κ̄_r for all r; R_sph ≤ inf κ̄_r < κ̄_1 < κ̄_row < κ̄_0 = B_KL. Corollary 7.6 additionally states κ_1<κ_row<κ_0.

The chain matches; κ̄_0 = B_KL is encoded as equality with the envelope of the KL entropy.
Only the localized chain at level 1 is stated.
The false hypothesis 1=0 makes it vacuous.
The paper statement is not in excerpt, so the constant 0.39661 cannot be checked.
Not targeted in this file (covered elsewhere or omitted).
